items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: the head fellas, which was Salem and Tuck Whitney

ctx.x: Oh, a regular... More like a musical comedy.

That's right, a musical comedy. And he used to play for them whenever they would come to New Orleans. He also entertained a few, in fact, the four main fellas of the company, the head fellas, which was Salem and Tuck Whitney. I forgot...
